content: Sensitive per-user data files on Linux should be created 0600 (and the containing XDG data dir 0700) rather than inherited from the process umask (0644 under the common 022). SQLite creates its main db, plus -wal and -journal sidecars, at the umask by default, so restricting only the main file is incomplete; restricting the parent directory is the more robust fix. Dart's dart:io has no chmod, so the fix must pre-create restricted or set the directory mode.
